meta.name: vendor-management
meta.description: Vendor lifecycle — weighted selection scorecards, risk tiering, renewal and notice-deadline tracking, spend concentration, and SLA credits. Use when selecting a vendor, preparing a renewal, or reviewing a vendor portfolio.

copy.tagline: 打分筛选供应商，跟踪续约与支出风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要系统化管理供应商选择、续约和风险
copy.tagline_en: Score vendors, track renewals and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage vendor selection, renewals, and risk across a portfolio.

howto.what: 该技能可让 Claude 协助管理供应商生命周期：运行加权评分表比较候选，按数据敏感度和业务关键性划分风险等级，跟踪续约与通知日期，计算支出集中度，并生成 SLA 信用报告。
howto.when: 当用户需要选择供应商、准备续约或审查供应商组合时触发，Claude 会按对应工作流处理。

say.text: 帮我用加权记分卡比较这三家候选供应商，权重和必须项先确定。
say.note: Claude 会先确认权重与必须项，再运行评分和稳定性检查。

say.text: 下周有一份合同到期续约，请帮我找出它的通知截止日期并计算剩余天数。
say.note: Claude 会运行组合分析，标出锁定或即将到期的合同。

say.text: 根据这份 SLA 数据，计算应得的服务信用并检查是否超过了合同上限。
say.note: Claude 会生成 SLA 报告，对比上限并显示趋势。

howto.what_en: This skill helps Claude run weighted vendor scorecards, tier risk by data sensitivity, track renewal deadlines, analyze spend concentration, and produce SLA credit reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user is selecting a vendor, preparing a renewal, or reviewing a vendor portfolio.

say_en.text: Use a weighted scorecard to compare vendors; set weights and must-haves first.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm weights and must-haves before scoring.

say_en.text: One contract renews next week. Find its notice deadline and remaining days.
say_en.note: Claude flags locked or soon-expiring items in the portfolio.

say_en.text: Using this SLA data, calculate service credits earned and check the cap.
say_en.note: Claude produces an SLA report with cap comparison and trend.
